en: How big or small something is; or a number that shows the measurements of clothes or shoes.
ex: What size shoes do you wear?
你穿幾號的鞋？

en: A piece of clothing for women that hangs from the waist; or to go around the edge of something.
ex: She wore a blue skirt and a white blouse.
她穿著藍色裙子和白色襯衫。

en: The space above the Earth where you can see clouds, the sun, the moon and stars.
ex: The sky was clear and full of stars last night.
昨晚天空晴朗，滿是星星。

en: To rest with your eyes closed and your mind not active; or the state of resting like this.
ex: I need to sleep for eight hours every night.
我每晚需要睡八小時。

en: Attractively thin; or to make yourself thinner by eating less.
ex: She is tall and slim and likes to run.
她又高又苗條，喜歡跑步。

en: Not moving or happening quickly; or to become slower.
ex: Please drive slowly because the road is wet.
路面濕滑，請慢慢開車。

en: Not large in size, amount or importance.
ex: They live in a small house near the sea.
他們住在海邊一間小房子裡。

en: Intelligent and quick at learning; or neatly dressed; or (of technology) able to work automatically.
ex: She is a smart girl who always gets good grades.
她是個聰明的女孩，成績一直很好。

en: A quality that you notice with your nose; or to notice something with your nose.
ex: I can smell something delicious from the kitchen.
我聞到廚房傳來香味。

en: To turn the corners of your mouth up to show that you are happy; or a happy expression on your face.
ex: She smiled at me when I came into the room.
我走進房間時她對我微笑。

en: A gray or black cloud given off by something burning; or to breathe in smoke from a cigarette.
ex: Thick smoke came out of the burning building.
濃煙從著火的大樓冒出。

en: A long, thin reptile with no legs that moves along the ground; or to move in curves.
ex: A snake slid through the grass and disappeared.
一條蛇滑過草叢消失了。

en: Soft white pieces of frozen water that fall from the sky in cold weather; or to fall as snow.
ex: It snowed all night and the roads are white.
整夜下雪，道路都變白了。

en: Used to give the reason or result of something; or to a high degree; or also.
ex: It was raining, so we stayed at home.
在下雨，所以我們待在家裡。

en: A long, comfortable seat with a back and arms for two or more people.
ex: The cat is sleeping on the sofa.
貓正睡在沙發上。

en: A person who is a member of an army; or to continue to do something in spite of difficulties.
ex: The soldier stood guard at the gate.
那名士兵在門口站崗。

en: An amount or number of something that is not stated; or about; or a particular one.
ex: Would you like some more tea?
你想再來一點茶嗎？

en: A person who is not named or known.
ex: Someone is knocking at the door.
有人在敲門。

en: A thing that is not named or known.
ex: I need something to drink; I am very thirsty.
我需要喝點東西，我很渴。

en: At some times but not always.
ex: Sometimes I walk to school and sometimes I take the bus.
有時我走路上學，有時我搭公車。

en: In, at or to a place that is not known or not named.
ex: I left my keys somewhere in the house.
我把鑰匙留在家裡某個地方了。

en: Your male child.
ex: Their son is studying at university.
他們的兒子在念大學。

en: A piece of music with words that you sing; or the musical sound that a bird makes.
ex: She sang her favorite song at the party.
她在派對上唱了她最喜歡的歌。

en: In a short time from now; or early.
ex: The train will arrive soon.
火車很快就會到。

en: Painful and uncomfortable, especially because of an injury or infection; or a painful place on the body.
ex: I have a sore throat and I can't speak well.
我喉嚨痛，說不好話。

en: Feeling sad or ashamed about something you did; or used when you say you apologize.
ex: I am sorry for being late again.
我很抱歉又遲到了。

en: Something that you can hear; or to seem a certain way when you hear it; or healthy and in good condition.
ex: I heard a strange sound outside the window.
我聽到窗外傳來奇怪的聲音。

en: A liquid food made by cooking meat, fish or vegetables in water.
ex: We had a bowl of hot soup on the cold day.
天冷的那天我們喝了一碗熱湯。

en: The direction toward the bottom of a map; or the direction opposite to the north.
ex: Birds fly south for the winter.
鳥類在冬天往南飛。

en: An empty area where you can put things; or the universe beyond the Earth; or a gap between things.
ex: There is not much space in my small room.
我的小房間裡沒什麼空間。

en: To use your voice to say words; or to be able to talk in a language; or to give a speech.
ex: Can you speak English and French?
你會說英語和法語嗎？

en: Better than or different from what is normal; or intended for a particular purpose.
ex: Tonight is a special night for our family.
今晚對我們家來說是特別的夜晚。

en: To say or write the letters of a word in the correct order; or a period of time; or a magic charm.
ex: How do you spell your name?
你的名字怎麼拼？

en: To use money to buy something; or to use time doing something; or to use all of something.
ex: I spent all my money on a new bike.
我把所有的錢都花在一輛新腳踏車上。

en: The season of the year after winter, when plants begin to grow; or a coil of metal; or a place where water comes from the ground.
ex: Flowers bloom in spring.
春天時花朵盛開。

en: A shape with four equal sides and four right angles; or an open area in a town; or fair.
ex: We met in the town square at noon.
我們中午在城鎮廣場碰面。

en: A set of steps that lead from one floor of a building to another; one of these steps.
ex: She ran up the stairs to answer the phone.
她跑上樓去接電話。

en: To be on your feet; or to rise to your feet; or to be located in a place; or to put up with something.
ex: Please stand up when the teacher comes in.
老師進來時請起立。

en: A very large ball of burning gas in space that you can see at night; or a very famous person; or a symbol *.
ex: You can see many stars in the sky on a clear night.
晴朗的夜晚能在天空看到許多星星。

en: To begin doing something; or the beginning of something; or to leave on a journey.
ex: The class starts at eight in the morning.
課程在早上八點開始。
